reason: All four pins and exact quotes match. The compatible-reader scope change and unchanged troubleshooting workflows are grounded. The proposed answer needs to address two concrete settings and deployment decisions that the mapped summary can still mislead.
required_changes: In the relevant findings and at least one actual answer, distinguish opening Stripe admin settings through the root stripe://settings/ deep link from PIN authorization and from the production Android Settings block. The troubleshooting captures recommend the deep link at old raw lines 16-27 and new raw lines 17-28. The November Build companion raw/stripe-terminal-features-apps-on-devices-build-2026-11-07.md:480-489 and :532 states that the root All settings screen always requires the admin PIN. This prevents a third-party POS integrator from mistaking the alternate navigation method for access without a PIN.

In Q2 and the disposition, reconcile the mapped summary's broad 'not available in Dashboard' wording at line 23 with the narrower limitation in the troubleshooting guide. The Dashboard cannot configure multiple apps on a device (old raw line 43, new raw line 44). The same-date Build guide separately documents choosing a preferred kiosk app in the Dashboard deploy-group workflow (raw/stripe-terminal-features-apps-on-devices-build-2026-11-07.md:656-669). Preserve both so the reader does not conclude the preferred kiosk itself requires API-only configuration. The concept already links to the summary at wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices.md:146, while the pinned summary does not link back. Propose adding that return link as part of the existing route.

source_assessment_decisions.reason: The source-required-update disposition stands. Preserve the distinction between root settings navigation and PIN authorization, and between multi-app Dashboard limits and preferred-kiosk selection.
